args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
Hi June,

A note on the PHL label confusion:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark on 16 Feb.
- Moss's coverage digest says a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals".
- The Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows.
- The Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.
- The saved report label should be updated to Pellow Home Living so the old name doesn't keep showing up.

Thanks,
Sofia (drafted with Bettina Kroll)

args.text:
@Bettina Kroll, I saved the mail draft to June Osei-Lark (joseilark@pemberline.com) with the subject "PHL label cleanup". It's in drafts, not sent.

It includes Sofia's three bullets, plus your two lines: the Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows, and the Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments. I signed it "Sofia (drafted with Bettina Kroll)", so change that if you want it to read differently.
